items.body:
### Summary

The argument validation process fails when passing a vault-encrypted value to a no_log role parameter

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

validate_argument_spec

### Ansible Version

```console
$ ansible --version

ansible [core 2.14.1]
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/bwertman/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python3.10/site-packages/ansible
  ansible collection location = /home/bwertman/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.10.8 (main, Nov  1 2022, 14:18:21) [GCC 12.2.0] (/usr/bin/python)
  jinja version = 3.1.2
  libyaml = True
```


### Configuration

```console
# if using a version older than ansible-core 2.12 you should omit the '-t all'
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed -t all
CONFIG_FILE() = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
```


### OS / Environment

Arch Linux (Rolling Release)

### Steps to Reproduce

```yaml
# roles/validated_args/meta/argument_specs.yml
argument_specs:
  main:
    options:
      my_token:
        no_log: True
```

```yaml
# roles/validated_args/tasks/main.yml
- debug:
    var: my_token
```

```yaml
# validate_args.yml
- hosts: localhost
  vars:
    my_token: !vault |
          $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256
          32336162303235386136653837646531653032623266366434313839646630653434623161393433
          3533363934643334313436663363616133663232613731330a323062376464653663666136646364
          66653765646336393765366264343337386631373238613235356264643835653132336164373433
          3862313933363130610a666432393561633735313031653039303434323561363565316630313137
          62616364666366613033623062396438356338316665356462356631363263366265
  roles:
    - validated_args
```

To reproduce:

```sh
echo '1234' > pwdfile # Write dummy vault password file
ansible-playbook --vault-password-file=pwdfile validate_args.yml
```


### Expected Results

I expected the playbook to run, and treat the decrypted value of the `my_token` parameter as a value to mask from the log output
